result.brief: FLEX-WAM 提出块因果、可 KV 缓存的世界-动作模型，支持变长上下文与无限自回归 rollout，并用前向动力学弹性调节动作响应，实现长时序想象与规划。
result.reason: Block-causal action-conditioned world-action model with joint video-action prediction, long-horizon rollouts, and planning in imagination; primary world-model contribution with robot application.
